scope: Seven independently AI-generated concept stills; none is a generated video or a guaranteed precise first frame.

concepts.title: 沿海长卷
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished concept still for a possible scenic short film, wide 16:9 landscape, full bleed.
Input image 1 is a reference for the visual world, rider identity, natural materials and richness of light; choose a new composition for the stated concept.
Keep the reference world's blue and turquoise bay, monumental pale limestone cliffs and stone arcades, grassy slopes and wildflowers. One adult cyclist wears a red jersey, black helmet, black shorts and a dark backpack and rides an ordinary anatomically coherent two-wheel mountain bicycle.
The scenery is the main spectacle; the cyclist establishes scale and a readable route. Cinematic dreamlike environmental art, believable rock, water, grass and masonry textures, luminous layered atmosphere, selective rich color, warm sunlight from the left unless the concept specifies twilight.
Exactly one integrated scene. No text, labels, logos, watermark, borders, panels, split-screen, typography, interface, or explanatory diagram. This is a concept visualization, not a claim that a video has been made.

Concept: A long coastal landscape revealed by a side-rear parallel tracking viewpoint. Stage the cyclist riding steadily across the lower foreground along a continuous safe grassy dirt path, seen from the rear-side in a clear grounded pedaling posture. The bay and enormous cliff arcades extend like a long visual scroll across the middle and far distance. Strong layers of passing flowers and rocks, rider and hillside, water and remote cliffs suggest lateral parallax. Keep both wheels grounded, landscape expansive, camera neither directly behind nor directly overhead. Focus on elegant scenic travel, not a stunt.
concepts.referenceRole: Visual world, character appearance, materials and lighting; not an exact video first frame
concepts.intent: concept still only; no video generation
concepts.observation: 侧后方骑手、前景花石和横向展开的海湾拱廊构成沿海长卷。
concepts.limit: 原静帧评审时，平行跟拍和横向视差尚未生成或验证；现运动与接缝结果见currentVideoTrials及拼接记录。静帧本身不证明运动质量，原10秒分镜也未逐项精确通过。
concepts.modelIdNote: Built-in tool did not return a specific model identifier.
concepts.videoStatusAtImageGeneration: not generated at the original concept-image review

currentVideoTrial.status: completed; real two-clip splice tested; seam broadly continuous with slight redraw; not strictly seamless
currentVideoTrial.boundary_input: A actual frame120 was B first-image input; A frame120 was excluded from the edit to avoid a repeated similar boundary pose. Input identity does not guarantee identical generated B frame0 or velocity.
currentVideoTrial.editing: Source dimensions normalized to1280x720; no loop, freeze frame, retiming or dissolve.
observations: Character, pedaling phase and main geography broadly continue across the5s cut.
Minor character and grass redraw/softening remains.
A still approaches slightly; B pulls back visibly in its later part.

Concept: A still pool in the foreground reflects a colossal arched stone gateway set into a sea cliff. In the real upper scene, the solid stone door is fully CLOSED, opaque and visibly joined. In the water reflection directly below that same doorway, its reflected door leaves are partly OPEN and reveal luminous blue water beyond. Show the real closed door and its contradictory open reflection clearly within the SAME camera view, aligned to the reflective water surface. Use a low oblique wide viewpoint, with bay cliffs and flowers around it and one small red cyclist on the shore path. The single magical rule is that the reflection anticipates the door opening. Avoid two real doors, a mirror frame, a diptych, a duplicate landscape, or an open real doorway. The water remains recognizably water with subtle ripples.

concepts.observation: 实体石门闭合，水中对应位置出现开启的门与蓝色海湾，二者同框。
concepts.limit: 倒影采用魔法式表达，几何不是严格的光学镜像；开门先后顺序仍需视频验证。

Concept: A single delicate dandelion parachute seed carries a tiny palm-sized patch of grassy island and a miniature pale stone arch above the wildflower verge. The seed's stem and fine filaments are clear, and flowers and grass blades give a convincing miniature scale cue. This is a fragile small floating ecosystem, not a gigantic flying continent. In the lower foreground or a few meters behind the seed, the normal-size adult red cyclist rides past on the grounded trail, not on the floating island. Beyond them the huge blue bay and cliff arcades remain the world. Compose a close scenic encounter that lets the small wonder and the grand setting be read together. Natural textures, delicate warm left light, no extra islands or extra cyclists.

Concept: Twilight in the same cliff-and-bay world. The red cyclist is visibly pedaling forward along the coastal path. A single contiguous section of the distant monumental stone arcades along that route has just lit up with warm amber window light, while the remaining arcades ahead are still dark blue and unlit. Arrange the lit section and the dark continuation so a viewer can imagine a wave of light being awakened along the route by forward movement. Keep the scene calm and majestic: deep blue water, blue-violet dusk, the last warm light from the left, textured stone and grassy foreground. Do not turn every building on; retain a clearly visible boundary between awakened golden arches and the still-dark next section. The scenery is the main spectacle; the cyclist establishes scale and a readable route. Cinematic dreamlike environmental art, believable rock, water, grass and masonry textures, luminous layered atmosphere, selective rich color, warm sunlight from the left unless the concept specifies twilight.

Concept: One massive stone arch on the same coastal trail forms a seamless threshold between summer and winter. The near side of the continuous road lies in sunlit summer grass and wildflowers; beyond the arch and along the connected far side are snow-covered ground, frosted trees and a wintry version of the same bay cliffs. The geological coastline and the physical road remain coherent through the doorway. The red cyclist rides from the warm grassy foreground toward the arch, both wheels grounded. Use an oblique rear-side wide camera so the summer foreground, stone threshold and winter vista are all readable. Preserve warm directional light from the left while allowing cool snow shadows. This is one world with a magical seasonal boundary, not two separate postcard panels or a collage.

concepts.intent: concept still only; no video generation
concepts.observation: 同一拱门前是暖阳草地，门后是雪地、结霜树木和冬季海湾，骑手驶向门。
concepts.limit: 本图是夏→冬视觉变体；当前视频分镜脚本采用夏→深秋，季节和装备连续性需在制作前统一。
